entities.summary: Anna Burnet is a British Olympic silver medallist and two-time world champion in sailings Mixed multihull Olympic discipline. She lives in Scotland. In 2020 she became world champion in the Nacra 17 World Championship with partner John Gimson. They were selected for the British Olympic team and gained silver medals at the 2020 Summer Olympics. The duo have won many international medals in the Olympic discipline highlights include winning the World championships twice 2020/2021. They have also won the European championships three times 2021,2023,2025.
